gloss: beautiful appearance; fine view; aesthetic appeal

definitions.gloss: beautiful appearance; fine view; scenic beauty; aesthetic appeal
definitions.explanation: The beautiful visual appearance of a place, building, or area, especially as something to be preserved or maintained.

examples.japanese: ⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美観|びかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
examples.english: To preserve the beauty of the town.

examples.japanese: ⟦{違法|いほう}→違法：09687_ihou⟧な⟦{看板|かんばん}→看板：00166_kanban⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{美観|びかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{損|そこ}なう→損なう：18061_sokonau⟧。
examples.english: Illegal signs damage the aesthetic appearance.

examples.japanese: {倉敷|くらしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美観|びかん}⟦{地区|ちく}→地区：03463_chiku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{白壁|しらかべ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{蔵|くら}→蔵：13991_kura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧だ。
examples.english: The Kurashiki aesthetic district is a beautiful area lined with white-walled storehouses.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{美|び}→美：28891_bi⟧ (beauty) + {観|かん} (view, appearance). Often used in the context of urban planning, preservation, and regulations about maintaining the visual quality of an area.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美観|びかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧ — to protect the beautiful appearance
- {美観|びかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{損|そこ}なう→損なう：18061_sokonau⟧ — to damage the aesthetic appearance
- {美観|びかん}⟦{地区|ちく}→地区：03463_chiku⟧ — aesthetic/scenic district (a legally designated area)
- ⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧{美観|びかん} — urban aesthetics
- {美観|びかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧ — to maintain the beauty

CULTURAL NOTE:
{美観|びかん}⟦{地区|ちく}→地区：03463_chiku⟧ (aesthetic districts) are designated areas in Japanese cities where building appearance and signage are regulated to preserve traditional or scenic beauty. The most famous is the {倉敷|くらしき}{美観|びかん}⟦{地区|ちく}→地区：03463_chiku⟧ in Okayama Prefecture.

- ⟦{外観|がいかん}→外観：12154_gaikan⟧ — outward appearance (of a building or object)
